parsed.answer: As of August 22, Ivo’s Cobalt project uses STREAM-1-286 delivery, approved on August 15, and retry policy RETRY-1-907, which supersedes RETRY-1-108. For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8: REPLAY-1-632. The August 8 test did not itself approve a delivery-mode change.

citations.quote: 2026-08-15. Ivo approved switching Cobalt from BATCH-1-741 to STREAM-1-286. This supersedes the August 1 delivery decision. The cause was the GATE-1-519 outages recorded on August 8; keep the successful recovery procedure from that incident.

2026-08-22. Ivo reviewed Cobalt. Keep the August 15 delivery choice. For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8. The retry policy is now RETRY-1-907, superseding RETRY-1-108.
The team tested REPLAY-1-632, which restored the missing updates. No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
